characters.prompt: Create a production-ready character expression and pose sprite sheet based on the attached reference character. Use case: stylized-concept. EXACTLY SIX full-body characters in a strict 3-column by 2-row grid on a landscape 1536x1024 canvas, each cell exactly 512x512 with no visible borders or labels. Centers at (256,256),(768,256),(1280,256),(256,768),(768,768),(1280,768). Every entire character must fit safely within its own cell with at least 50px transparent padding around all sides. Same character size, same frontal 3/4 angle, consistent face/outfit/materials across all six. Premium soft 3D clay-toy matte render. Actual transparent alpha background, clean edges, NO colored fringes, no ground, no floating symbols, no confetti, no text, no grid lines, no watermark. Keep paws rounded and anatomy simple. Row-major six frames exactly: TOP LEFT idle: standing relaxed, open kind eyes, small closed-mouth smile, arms at sides. TOP MIDDLE thinking: one paw on chin, eyes glance upward, little closed thoughtful mouth. TOP RIGHT talking closed: facing viewer with one paw slightly raised in a natural explaining gesture, closed smiling mouth. BOTTOM LEFT talking open: precisely same body/arm/head pose and position as TOP RIGHT, change ONLY mouth to a small open speaking oval. BOTTOM MIDDLE cheering: both paws joyfully raised, eyes joyful crescents, wide happy smile, little celebratory jump. BOTTOM RIGHT resting: seated comfortably, paws on lap, gently closed eyes, tiny peaceful closed-mouth smile. This is for a friendly running companion, all moods warm and approachable. CHARACTER CHANGE REQUIRED: recolor the reference bear's mint-green fur to a beautiful warm medium cocoa brown (#A46D46), and make inner ears and muzzle and belly warm cream (#F5DEC5). Brown fur in ALL SIX FRAMES, no mint or green anywhere. Preserve the round bear ears, round face and original navy athletic vest, yellow zipper, navy wristwatch and white running sneakers. The brown bear should be distinct from a squirrel, no striped forehead and no large tail.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production transparent mascot animation sprite sheet for LOCAL STRIDE running companion app.
Create ONE cute anthropomorphic turtle running mascot named Kkubugi. A polished soft 3D clay/plush toy character in the same family as a warm brown teddy bear wearing navy running vest and a caramel squirrel wearing blue/yellow running gear. Round oversized head, small plump body, short limbs, tiny black oval eyes, warm blush cheeks, very gentle confident smile. Pale sage-green skin, cream belly, rounded olive-green segmented shell visibly peeking around the back/shoulders so it reads unmistakably as a turtle. Yellow sports headband, navy sleeveless running vest with yellow zipper, white running sneakers with navy accents, tiny navy sport watch. No fur, no rabbit ears, no beak, no spikes. Charming original design, kind steady running buddy, not a ninja.
Exact output composition: 1536 x 1024 landscape RGBA PNG, true transparent background. Strict invisible 3-column x 2-row grid of SIX 512 x 512 square cells. One full-body turtle centered in each cell, no cropping, no overlap into another cell, approximately 420 px tall, 40 px padding, consistent head/body size and camera angle in all six. Soft studio lighting baked into character only. Clear alpha everywhere outside character, including cell corners; no background color, no vignette, no glow, no floor, no text, no labels, no watermark, no grid lines, no props beyond worn running gear.
Order, left to right then top to bottom:
1 top-left: idle, standing comfortably, relaxed arms, closed-mouth friendly smile.
2 top-middle: thinking, one hand touching chin, curious eyes glancing slightly up.
3 top-right: speaking CLOSED mouth, right hand raised in a small welcoming conversational gesture.
4 bottom-left: speaking OPEN mouth, precisely the same pose/scale/orientation/placement as cell 3, only the mouth changes to a friendly speaking shape; these two are animation frames.
5 bottom-middle: cheering, delighted eyes curved closed, happy open-mouth smile, both arms lifted, one sneaker lifted in a small joyful running hop.
6 bottom-right: resting, seated comfortably with legs forward and sneakers visible, relaxed closed eyes and peaceful smile.
Make all poses easily recognizable even at 80 px thumbnail size. Preserve consistent face, shell, costume and proportions in every cell.
